entries.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original seamless tileable base-color texture for a Unity URP medieval village game, a single square image. Primary request: flat orthographic photogrammetry-quality texture of aged grey and warm limestone rubble masonry, irregular medium-small rough cut blocks fitted in courses with thin recessed dull lime mortar, believable chips, fine pores, subtle old damp mottling, restrained sparse moss in crevices. Covers about 2 by 2 meters of wall. Color palette: neutral grey, muted warm taupe, soft charcoal mortar, no orange saturation. Lighting: perfectly even diffuse ambient light, unlit albedo appearance, NO directional shadows, NO vignette, NO perspective, NO glossy highlights. Composition: surface completely fills the square, seamless matching edges left/right and top/bottom, repeatable pattern with no unique focal feature. High frequency tactile stone detail and moderate contrast; not a rendered wall in a scene. No windows, objects, people, borders, labels, symbols or text. Realistic dark medieval fantasy material, original, no franchise references.
entries.use: Unity URP albedo surface; not a gameplay screenshot or 3D model
